data.body: **[P2] Test the documented layer-only dependency contract.** This conformance artifact still shades `opentelemetry-sdk`, so it can supply application-side SDK classes that the single-JAR layer omits. The cloud suite can therefore pass while documented functions without extra OTel dependencies fail to load the plugin. Remove that dependency and assert the handler contains no OTel SDK classes; if the test then fails, package the required runtime classes or document them as required.
